description.zh-CN: 高性能开源代码编辑器（Rust 原生）：毫秒级启动，内置 AI 智能体面板，也能直接接入 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等外部智能体。
description.en: A high-performance open-source code editor written in Rust: instant startup, a built-in AI agent panel, and direct integration with external agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode.

node.recommended: not required (native Rust binary; statically linked CRT)
node.supported: not required (native Rust binary; statically linked CRT)

runtime.note: Native Rust build — no Node, Python, .NET or VC++ redistributable needed. Requires a DirectX 11 GPU. Ships its own ConPTY (no Windows Terminal needed). Extensions run on an embedded WASM runtime; language servers are downloaded by Zed itself.

packages.name: Zed (Inno Setup installer, win32-x64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-19, upstream published sha256; verified by direct download)

channels.note: Official Inno Setup installer — installs per-user into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Zed, no admin rights needed

install.notes: Inno Setup installer (upstream zed.iss: PrivilegesRequired=lowest → per-user, no admin). /VERYSILENT is the Inno silent switch; /TASKS with !prefix deselects the default file-associations / context-menu / PATH tasks so a fresh install does not modify the system (upstream defaults associatewithfiles + addcontextmenufiles + addtopath to ON). Verified on a real Windows machine 2026-11-19: exit code 0, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Zed\Zed.exe present, app starts and the extension host loads.

upgrade.notes: Run the newer installer over the existing per-user install. Zed also updates itself in the background (tools\auto_update_helper.exe), so the registry sha256 applies to the first install.

steps: Windows: Settings → Apps → Zed → Uninstall (or run %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Zed\unins000.exe)
macOS: drag Zed.app from Applications to the Trash
Delete user data folders (see data paths) if you want a clean slate
uninstall.notes: The uninstaller removes the file associations, PATH entry and context-menu package it added, but it keeps your settings, key bindings, themes and snippets — those live in the data folders.

risk.onUninstall: 设置、快捷键、主题、代码片段和历史都在数据目录，删除即丢失，建议先备份
